name: io.github.AKzar1el/digestseo-mcp
title: DigestSEO AI Visibility
description: Track how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews cite your brand.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key — enables the ChatGPT engine. All five engine keys are optional, but at least one must be set.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key — enables the Claude engine plus prompt generation and content-gap analysis (Claude Haiku). Optional; at least one engine key must be set.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google AI Studio API key — enables the Gemini engine (free tier available). Optional; at least one engine key must be set.

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Perplexity API key — enables the Perplexity Sonar engine. Optional; at least one engine key must be set.

environmentVariables.name: SERPAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SerpAPI key — enables the Google AI Overviews engine. Optional; at least one engine key must be set.

worker_domain.description: Hostname of your self-deployed Cloudflare Worker, as printed by `wrangler deploy` (see SETUP.md or llms-install.md)

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Two deploy modes: run locally via `npx -y digestseo-mcp` (SQLite at ~/.digestseo, bring your own engine API keys), or self-host the Cloudflare Worker (D1 + cron auto-refresh; see SETUP.md or llms-install.md) and connect to your Worker URL at /mcp. Engines are opt-in: each of the five engines activates only when its API key is set.
